title: LyricsProcessingFailed
description: Published by Lyrics on routing key lyrics.failed when it gives up on a song's lyrics: immediately for a permanent problem (e.g. invalid LRC), or after the 3rd attempt for a transient one. The SongUploaded message is also moved to lyrics.song-uploaded.dlq. Catalogue sets lyrics_status = FAILED.

error_code.description: Machine-readable reason, e.g. INVALID_EVENT, LYRICS_FILE_NOT_FOUND, LYRICS_TOO_LARGE, LYRICS_INVALID_ENCODING, LYRICS_INVALID, LYRICS_NOT_TIMESTAMPED, PROCESSING_ERROR.

message.description: Human-readable detail for logs and the UI.

attempts.description: How many times processing was attempted before giving up.
